_comment: Curated hard/differentiating Python subset of RATBench python_repos_all.json (500). Over-weights cases where Repo2Run (44.8 ESSR) and RAT (63.2 ESSR) struggle; excludes benchmark-impossible repos (GPU/CUDA, ML monorepos, multi-service, native>=35%, code_bytes>20MB). Heuristic selection by repo features + paper aggregate findings (no per-repo RAT/Repo2Run labels exist for the 500). Tiers: smoke (run first), extended.
_categories: documented_rat_failure | repo2run_weak_ci_service(S2) | repo2run_weak_test_deficient(S3) | connection_error_stress | native_runtime_stress | winnable_large | easy_control | hard_general(top-up)

repos._why: Dockerfile + backend/service → system-service deps invisible to requirements.txt; Repo2Run S2 collapse (25.4 vs RAT 69.5)
Pure-Python lib/CLI, no container; test-deficient pattern
